description: Infer a JSON Schema (draft-07) from a sample JSON value. Detects types, required fields, array item shapes, nested objects, and common string formats (email, uri, date, date-time, uuid). Returns a ready-to-use schema compatible with json_schema_validate. Use when you have a sample API response or LLM output and want to auto-generate a validation schema for CI/CD testing.

input.description: The sample JSON value to infer the schema from — a JSON string, or the value itself.

required_all.description: Mark all detected object properties as required (default: true)

name: json_schema_generate
